versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Spiders that start every fight hidden under trapdoor Lids, springing out with a free first strike when something knocks.
Open Lids give in-fight strikes and chains; Lids kept shut through a win make units Patient and grow them.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Closed the rules gaps: The Past Master doubles only Spring text, the Worshipful Master counts 4 opened Lids, re-closed Lids wait for their next Knock, and the Sexton's stacking is a keyword.
Also: the Spring target and Patient are stated plainly, scouted doors show their Knock, and the Orbweaver now feeds the Spring build permanently.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Wording fixes: Corkhinge's +4/+4 goes to the springing unit, Tapwell opens a Lid not an open unit, and a Spring on an attack Knock lands first and cancels the attack if it kills.
Two opens-last Lids no longer stall (reading order decides), and the Ballot Clerk also pays when Lids opened, so both builds want it.
